provenance.notes: Datasheet: Nichicon UVR miniature aluminum electrolytic series sheet (4 pages), part UVR1E221MPD = 220 µF, 25 V, case 8 x 11.5 mm. Specifications table p.1: tolerance ±20% at 120 Hz, 20 °C; rated voltage 6.3 to 450 V and capacitance 1 to 22000 µF (property limits); leakage current at most 0.01CV µA after 2 minutes at rated voltage (I in µA, C in µF, V in V; 0.03CV after 1 minute); tan δ max 0.16 at 25 V (120 Hz, 20 °C). Part table: 220 µF 25 V, 8x11.5, tan δ 0.16, leakage 165 µA at 1 minute and 55 µA at 2 minutes (matches 0.03CV and 0.01CV), rated ripple 330 mA rms at 85 °C, 120 Hz. ESR is not tabulated; at the part's own capacitance C it is about tan δ / (2π x 120 Hz x C), which is 0.97 Ω for 220 µF, a derived figure and not a datasheet value. Radial-lead drawing p.1 and its dimension table: ød 0.6 and P (lead spacing) 3.5±0.5 for ØD 8; ØD + 0.5 max for the sleeve; length L ± 1.5 for L up to 20 mm. The drawing marks the longer lead ⊕ and the shorter lead ⊖ (15 mm minimum for the ⊖ lead, 4 mm more for the ⊕ lead). The sheet only says 'printed with white letter on black sleeve' and draws no polarity stripe, so the stripe is not confirmed here; the ⊖ lead and the marked side are the datasheet's polarity cues. Not in the kit: the SunFounder component list image has no electrolytic capacitor. Spans: minSpan 1 needs the 3.5 mm leads bent in by about 0.5 mm each to the 2.54 mm grid; 2 pitches (5.08 mm) bends them out by a similar amount. maxSpan 6 = floor((3.5 + 2 x (15 - 8)) / 2.54); 15 mm is the minimum ⊖ lead length and the 8 mm bend/insertion allowance is a modelling assumption. bodyMm is [sleeve diameter max, sleeve diameter max, nominal length]. Default 220 µF / 25 V is the exact row the dimensions describe; other values change the can size.
